sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 19 (quality #18), Internal Quality Checks row 19; complete quality/deterministic inventories read via openpyxl, applicable internal annotations inspected
evidence:
The workbook and quality-checks.md:79-81 ask whether the golden plausibly satisfies every scored criterion; no graded behavior lacking a working reference implementation was found. Walked both gate criteria, all 80 functional criteria, six polish criteria and six visual anchors against the frozen source and their scenario instructions. Source support includes solution/app/src/runtime.ts:29-72,110-155,156-280,309-397 (filename dispatch, error locations, isolation, deadline guards, console, captured form/canvas render and rollback); src/app.tsx:44-89,108-151 (editor, save/conflict/history/retry UI, automatic-run cancellation and accessible controls); server.js:65-118,142-168 (transactional current records, immutable snapshots, revision checks and durable idempotent restores). Visual screenshots show readable consistent typography, contrasting states, grouped editor/library/history and preview/console surfaces, with deliberate mobile stacking. This is a plausibility assessment, not a claimed perfect Likert score.

Verified all 60 indexed raw artifact SHA256 values (evidence/18/artifact-hashes.json); all 43 proof-input source hashes match the frozen task (proof-source-hashes.json). Both the supplied full-install binding and the independently installed /app bytes match the frozen solution. Independently ran actual solve.sh into an isolated qc-coldwater-history:r2 container cw-row18-r2, starting node /app/server.js from /tmp with image-global SQLite and no local node_modules. Executed the retained functional and history browser drivers, both gate/six-polish surface probes, an added exact S22 Primary fixture, actual Docker process restart, full collection/history/restore replay readback, and a fresh-page UI update of Primary. independent-functional-map.json maps every one of the 80 criterion IDs to an actual passing runtime/history/post fact; all protocol observations completed. history-results.json also records the actual lost-reply UI retry separately from API replay. surface-results.json records both gates and all six polish outcomes. The independent stop/canvas/input/error/deadline observations retain real values, lines, pixels, controls and elapsed times rather than just a coverage flag.

The supplied post-results.json originally checked three history fixtures before S21 Alpha/Beta existed. That scope limit is closed by this reviewer's independent ordering and added fixture: primary-setup.json records 12 current records, explicitly including HTML Beta, JS Alpha, the gate record and updated Primary before restart; post-results.json proves exact current-record and all-history equality plus unchanged late restore retry; primary-post.json proves the UI Save advances Primary from revision 2 to 3, survives fresh UI reload, and leaves all unrelated records unchanged. Desktop/mobile screenshots were visually inspected. mobile-preview-viewport.png and its command log additionally show the authored preview visibly rendered after ordinary scrolling; the offscreen blank area in full-page captures is not taken as evidence of a broken preview.

Adversarial checks: the hash-verified raw computed-mock-gate.json shows a literal-copy demo succeeds on its literal control but fails the computed-output gate, while the actual golden produces the fresh computed DOM/log output. A correct static restored preview is a conforming alternative that a live-handler requirement would wrongly reject; the frozen descriptors explicitly accept static preservation (functional judge.toml:49-56 and prompt.md:148-160), and the reference's actual Stop trial passes preservation while suppressing the previously working handlers. No such extra live-handler requirement was imposed. The local repeated runs are independent scope verification, not rerunning an unchanged failed candidate until green.

Limits remain explicit: these are local scripted observations and source review; the single-use verifier MCP restart helper, complete configured judge/test.sh execution, actual Oracle/model scores, provider timing and private deterministic checkers were not exercised by row 18. No Oracle grade, workload clearance or overall task clearance is inferred. The isolated container is stopped with its database retained; the shared cw-history-r2b-golden was not modified. All new raw commands, outcomes and hashes are under per-row-review/evidence/18/evidence-manifest.json. No row-18-required measurement remains missing.
